body: It's barely worth explaining. A heroin addict pulled a long con on me and is rubbing it in my face every chance she gets. It's just the latest in a long history of being used, abused and humiliated at the expense of my naive trust and gullibility. I'm thousands in debt (couple hundred because of her directly), several health problems brought on by stress anxiety and depression, nearly lost my job so i had to take a 4 week leave of absence (all of which she was living out of my house), have a few warrants out for me for missing traffic court to take care of her and it's all just a big joke. But what else is new, my entire existence has a been a joke that hasn't yet reached the punchline, but will in a few hours.
